author: Minecraft
description: Autobots, roll out. Decepticons, rise up. The TRANSFORMERS add-on is available on Minecraft Marketplace! Morph into one of 12 characters, including Optimus Prime and Megatron, each with unique abilities, weapons, and vehicles. Take on players in three different battle modes, like Deathmatch or Last Man Standing.
title: Minecraft x Transformers Add-on
